title: Player Interface
description:
The Player Interface is a block that allows you to access the inventory of your player as if it was a chest. It only works while the player who placed it is online.

The block has 4 different sides:

- Top: Armor

- Bottom: Hotbar

- North: Shield (offhand)

- East, South, West: Storage (the main inventory)

There also is the Creative Player Interface, which is only available in the creative menu.

properties.label: Sides
properties.value: Top: Armor, Bottom: Hotbar, North: Shield, other sides: Storage
